name: Acme Quarterly
tagline: A calm navy business-review deck with one sky-blue accent and three big numbers per slide.

palette.description: deep navy canvas, near-white text and one sky-blue accent

typography.style: one sans family: bold display headlines, regular body, small wide-tracked uppercase labels

best_for: Internal quarterly reviews and team updates with a few key figures per slide.
avoid_for: Dense tables, long text slides and public marketing keynotes.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
